Name: Diver's Best Friend - Automated Stratagem System (ASS)
Description: Revision 26: Diver's Best Friend branding across options, bindings and logs; clearer setting descriptions. Optional Select on Release remains off by default. Configurable Confirm input interval (0-250 ms, default 70); release sequences remain immediate. Native and expanded wheels gray and dim icons during cooldown or delivery. The selected stratagem shows its native remaining time below the name, restoring colors at expiry. Uses the original HUD timer state, including native special cases. Retains all layouts, wedge appearance controls and centering. Requires Mod Options Menu, Mod Bindings Menu v2 and Bingus Shared Loader API 1.
